title: Build organization and department scheduling UI
goal: Deliver contextual organization and department scheduling with headcount, assignments, conflicts, templates, publishing, and mobile agenda.

in: Open positions, templates, conflicts, overrides, publish diff
out: Compressing the desktop grid onto mobile

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All schedule lenses hydrate from URL state
Schedule content appears before exception details
One shift shows headcount and multiple assignments
Non-venue work has no fabricated venue
Publish failures preserve drafts and expose recovery
Production demo controls and sample records are absent
